## Mathematical repairs made after review (all in-batch scaffold text)

1. **Counterexample was arithmetically wrong.** `cex-spherical-and-antispherical-…` claimed `n_{e,s2s1}=1−v²` (wrong indices; it used `p_{w0,s2s1}=v`, impossible by support). Correct: `n_{e,s2s1}=p_{e,s2s1}−v·p_{s1,s2s1}=0`, vs spherical `m_{e,s2s1}=v²`. I verified by a from-scratch canonical-basis construction in `H_v(S_3)` under the library's published **multiplicative** bar convention (`lem-the-hecke-bar-involution-is-well-defined`), obtaining `D_{s2s1}=n_{s2s1}+v n_{s2}`, `C_{s2s1}=m_{s2s1}+v m_{s2}+v²m_e`. The conclusion (normalizations differ; substituting 0 for 1 gives a false multiplicity) stands.
2. **B example strategy** corrected to the matching computation; stray `and :` artifact removed.
3. **Escalated character formula** had a transposed index `S^{-1}_{x,y}`; corrected to `S^{-1}_{y,x}` (support `y≤x`, confirmed on the 3×3 example). Its escalation record is owner-held and precedes this text repair — a non-owner may not re-record it.
4. Two empty `()` artifacts from an earlier link-stripping pass removed (no math change). Affected ready records (4) plus the 6 transitively hashed dependents were re-recorded current.
